interface.signature: def can_transform(a: list[int], m: int, b: list[int]) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in a) and all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in b) and isinstance(m, int) and m >= 2
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays a and b are positive integers, and m is an integer ≥ 2.
Both input arrays a and b are non-empty.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sorted(a, key=lambda x: (x,)) == sorted(b, key=lambda x: (x,))) or (can_reach(a, m, b) == True)
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if array b can be obtained from array a by applying any number of the two operations (splitting or merging) with magic number m.
